title: An Integrative Multidimensional Conceptualization of Telework Behavior: A Systematic Review and Grounded Theory Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.17409v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Telework has expanded rapidly, and understanding the behaviors employees enact under it has become correspondingly important. This study develops an integrative conceptual framework specifying the multidimensional nature of telework behavior. A systematic literature review following PRISMA identified 114 review articles, which were analyzed using constructivist grounded theory. Six behavioral dimensions were identified, covering performance, communication, environmental, task, policy, and well-being conduct. Antecedents were grouped into individual factors, job characteristics, organizational norms, technological factors, and work environment factors. Outcomes were grouped into job satisfaction, productivity, turnover, health and well-being, work-life balance, and social isolation. translated_title: 远程办公行为的整合性多维概念化：一项系统性综述与扎根理论研究
translated_abstract: 远程办公迅速扩张，理解员工在远程办公情境下所展现的行为也相应变得日益重要。本研究构建了一个整合性概念框架，以阐明远程办公行为的多维性质。一项遵循PRISMA指南的系统性文献综述共识别出114篇综述文章，并采用建构主义扎根理论进行分析。研究识别出六个行为维度，涵盖绩效、沟通、环境、任务、政策以及身心健康相关行为。前因变量被归纳为个体因素、工作特征、组织规范、技术因素和工作环境因素五大类。结果变量被归纳为工作满意度、生产效率、离职、健康与福祉、工作生活平衡以及社会孤立六大类。研究还识别出三个情境调节变量，即远程办公模式、远程办公偏好以及文化与国家背景。十四条命题将这些构念相互关联（原文摘要至此处不完整）。
tldr: 本研究通过系统性文献综述与建构主义扎根理论，构建了一个整合性的远程办公行为多维概念框架，识别出六个行为维度、五类前因、六类结果和三个情境调节变量，并以十四条命题将各要素联系起来。
en_tdlr: This study develops an integrative multidimensional conceptual framework of telework behavior through a systematic review and constructivist grounded theory analysis, identifying six behavioral dimensions, five categories of antecedents, six categories of outcomes, three contextual moderators, and fourteen propositions linking these constructs together.
